I don’t have access to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the current temperature or forecast for San Francisco right now. However, here’s what you can generally expect:

| Season | Typical Temperature Range | Common Weather Patterns |
|--------|---------------------------|-------------------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy or foggy, especially near the coast. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 50–65 °F (10–18 °C) | Mild, occasional rain showers, still some fog. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 55–70 °F (13–21 °C) | Warm, dry, but coastal fog can linger in the mornings and evenings. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Pleasant, decreasing rainfall, cooler nights. |

If you need the current conditions, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like help finding a specific forecast or anything else!
